vitest_comment: web/vite.config.ts, not the root projects config: the meta gates scan the repo from disk with git ls-files, which has no meaning inside Stryker's sandbox. dir narrows collection to the app's own tests.
mutate_comment: web/src only. Deliberately narrower than the 100% coverage set in vitest.config.ts, which also covers meta/ and web/meta/ — mutating the gates would re-run their full-repo disk scans once per mutant. Keep the two lists divergent; if you change one, do not assume the other should follow.
